tasks.title: Implement repo_scan service (GitHub client, retry/timeout, structured logging, rollup upsert)
tasks.notes: Sole `httpx` importer for GitHub (D-03). Uses `app.core.retry.retry_with_backoff` (D-04). Per-request atomicity — the caller (T-04) owns the transaction boundary; this service performs the upsert on the passed `AsyncSession` and raises `GitHubScanError` on retry exhaustion so the router aborts without commit. Emits `admin_scan_completed` on success only, with fields exactly `{repos_total, repos_with_harness_installed, duration_ms, github_api_calls}`; never logs the PAT, `Authorization` header, or raw GitHub response bodies. Cites D-02 in a one-line comment at the upsert call site.
tasks.reason: scan_org_repos service with GitHub Link-pagination, 4-attempt retry, field-allowlist logger, atomic org_summary_rollup upsert (D-02 comment at call site).

tasks.title: Implement admin router (auth chain, wildcard-strict, status mapping)
tasks.notes: Follows `app/api/manifest.py`'s pattern (D-05): router-owned `HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)`, `get_ingest_token()` invoked as a plain coroutine with sentinel `program_id='*'`, then a router-level `'*' in token.allowed_program_ids` re-check (rejects allow-all-empty). Missing-config 500 check (FR-5) runs BEFORE any GitHub call and BEFORE any DB write. On success returns `ScanReposResponse`; on `GitHubScanError` returns 502 without committing the rollup. Never logs the bearer.
